title: Spirit & Opportunity
tagline: The twin rovers that found Mars once had water.
kicker: A true story from Mars · 2004 to 2018
mystery: Was Mars ever wet? Two robot geologists went to find out.
p1.where: January 2004. Two rovers land on Mars, three weeks apart.
p1.spirit: I'm Spirit! And this is my identical twin.
p1.opportunity: I'm Opportunity! Same wheels, same cameras, same arm.
p1.job: Our job: look for signs that water once flowed on Mars.
p1.apart: They landed on opposite sides of Mars, at places that looked once wet.
p2.where: Spirit's home: Gusev Crater, maybe an old lake.
p2.eyes: My cameras stand on a mast 1.4 m high, like a geologist looking around.
p2.tools: My arm grinds a rock open, to reach the fresh rock inside.
p2.read: Another tool reads which elements the rock is made of.
p2.hint: Tap a target. When I get there, hold the button until the bar is full.
p2.s.comanche: Comanche! Carbonates from a warm, wet Mars with gentle water.
p2.s.homeplate: Bright soil, 90% pure silica! On Earth that comes from hot springs.
p2.win: Hot springs and an ancient volcano, right here at Home Plate!
p3.where: Opportunity's home: Meridiani Planum, on the other side of Mars.
p3.hole: I landed right inside a little crater. A hole in one! Look at the ground...
p3.hint: Tap the small, round, grey balls. Not the brown pebbles!
p3.miss: That's a pebble. Blueberries are small, round and grey!
p3.win: Blueberries! Balls of hematite, a mineral that usually forms in water.
p3.acid: But that water was acidic. Hard for life to live in.
p4.solar: We ran on sunlight. Dust on our solar panels made us weak.
p4.hint: Rest to save power. Turn to the Sun. Wait for the wind!
p4.win: The Martian wind blew my panels clean. Thank you, wind!
p5.drive: Now let's drive. I want to see what's over the next hill!
p5.hint: Use the arrow keys or the joystick. Drive through each yellow ring.
p5.win: Over the hill and on to the next one!
p5.record: Opportunity drove 45.16 km, a record on another world for years.
p5.water: Together we proved it: long ago, water stayed on Mars for a long time.
p6.spirit: 2010. Spirit's mission ends at Home Plate.
p6.rest: This is my resting place, where an old volcano once steamed.
p6.storm: 10 June 2018. A dust storm covers the whole planet. Opportunity goes quiet.
p6.bye: My power is low and it's getting dark. Goodnight, Earth.
